source_note: The reference shows no dead tree: it is only the dark forest scene whose palette, evening light and voxel style the dead tree must match; draw only one dead tree and nothing else, no trees, no figures; use the reference pine only for the colours of its bark
design: a bare dead tree with a twisted grey-brown trunk and a few crooked leafless branches, cracked bark, no leaves or needles
